name: Football Bets
description: Football bet ledger — teams picked, wager, winnings and results. Kalshi positions and settlements import themselves over the read-only trade API; manual book bets (spread / total / moneyline) grade automatically from the live NFL scoreboard, with in-progress games projected live. Private: sportsbook.dabrewer.dev resolves to the Tailscale address, so it is reachable only on the tailnet.
